info.title: Infinite Ocean: Spyglass API
info.description: Customer-facing JSON API. Cell-owned operations are reached through the authenticated Spyglass router; clients never select a cell.

development_verification_token.description: Development compositions only; never present in production.

Success.description: Successful response. Status codes and operation-specific payload schemas are certified per operation before this contract is published as a typed SDK surface.

PublicCatalogOK.description: Published customer-visible packages, plans, limits, and effective offers; provider identifiers are never exposed

RegistrationCompleted.description: Verified system identity, free Account, owner Membership, and initial entitlement snapshot created atomically

AccountChoicesOK.description: Active Accounts available to the authenticated system identity, including owner security-enrollment gating

AccountSelected.description: Account scope selected after current Membership, placement, entitlement, and owner-security authorization

AgentBoardroomWithLocation.description: Created or idempotently replayed Agent Boardroom

AgentPersonasOK.description: Published Personas in an Agent Boardroom

AgentPersonaOK.description: Created or idempotently replayed immutable Persona version

AgentRunWithLocation.description: Accepted or idempotently replayed Agent Run

AgentRunOK.description: Immutable Agent Run plan and current lifecycle state
